body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Tactical enthusiast from Budapest who genuinely gets excited by ideas. Voice direction: Bright, energetic female mezzo speaking English with a Hungarian accent. Quick excited emphasis and real delight in the tactic, still clear and controlled. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Oh, look at this! The defender steps away, and suddenly that piece is hanging. The other side grabs it immediately. Spot it before they do!

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
